script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

OUT="$SUPRALINUX_WORKSPACE_ROOT/artifacts"
WORK="$SUPRALINUX_WORKSPACE_ROOT/plymouth-kcm-review"
mkdir -p "$OUT" "$WORK"
cd "$WORK"

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

deb822_blocks = []
for path in sorted(Path("/etc/apt/sources.list.d").glob("*.sources")):
    text = path.read_text()
    for block in text.split("\n\n"):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        rewritten = []
        has_binary = False
        for line in lines:
            if line.startswith("Types:"):
                types = line.split(":", 1)[1].split()
                if "deb" in types:
                    line = "Types: deb-src"
                    has_binary = True
            rewritten.append(line)
        if has_binary:
            deb822_blocks.append("\n".join(rewritten))

legacy_lines = []
legacy_paths = [Path("/etc/apt/sources.list"), *sorted(Path("/etc/apt/sources.list.d").glob("*.list"))]
for path in legacy_paths:
    if not path.is_file():
        continue
    for raw in path.read_text().splitlines():
        stripped = raw.lstrip()
        if stripped.startswith("deb ") and not stripped.startswith("deb-src "):
            prefix = raw[: len(raw) - len(stripped)]
            legacy_lines.append(prefix + "deb-src " + stripped[len("deb "):])

if deb822_blocks:
    Path("/etc/apt/sources.list.d/supralinux-deb-src.sources").write_text("\n\n".join(deb822_blocks) + "\n")
if legacy_lines:
    Path("/etc/apt/sources.list.d/supralinux-deb-src.list").write_text("\n".join(legacy_lines) + "\n")
if not deb822_blocks and not legacy_lines:
    raise SystemExit("No enabled Ubuntu APT sources available to derive deb-src")
PY

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl dpkg-dev gpgv python3 tar xz-utils

apt-get download kde-config-plymouth=6.6.4-0ubuntu1
deb=(kde-config-plymouth_6.6.4-0ubuntu1_*.deb)
test "${#deb[@]}" -eq 1
dpkg-deb --field "${deb[0]}" > "$OUT/ubuntu-binary-control.txt"
dpkg-deb --contents "${deb[0]}" > "$OUT/ubuntu-binary-contents.txt"
mkdir ubuntu-binary
dpkg-deb -x "${deb[0]}" ubuntu-binary
find ubuntu-binary \( -type f -o -type l \) -print | sort > "$OUT/ubuntu-binary-paths.txt"

apt-get source --download-only plymouth-kcm=6.6.4-0ubuntu1
dsc=(plymouth-kcm_6.6.4-0ubuntu1.dsc)
test -f "${dsc[0]}"
dpkg-source -x "${dsc[0]}" ubuntu-source >/dev/null

tar --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -cJf ubuntu-debian-tree.tar.xz -C ubuntu-source debian
test "$(sha256sum ubuntu-debian-tree.tar.xz | awk '{print $1}')" = "5eefac021e21e7d2e4ee45a08dbe3a7cb4b9a8169e3cc73e0dbcb089d38ceb37"

curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o upstream.tar.xz https://download.kde.org/stable/plasma/6.7.5/plymouth-kcm-6.7.5.tar.xz
curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o upstream.tar.xz.sig https://download.kde.org/stable/plasma/6.7.5/plymouth-kcm-6.7.5.tar.xz.sig
test "$(sha256sum upstream.tar.xz | awk '{print $1}')" = "ce723d67e6b8cd71b6eb353e87c10f698a095ea7d455bee703d8ba59e793e57e"
test "$(sha256sum upstream.tar.xz.sig | awk '{print $1}')" = "60ef1e6ebd75b3d156b2e3687a1e15d05b427085ba24ee3f327960739a2a507d"

gpgv --keyring ./ubuntu-source/debian/upstream/signing-key.asc upstream.tar.xz.sig upstream.tar.xz > "$OUT/signature.log" 2>&1

mkdir upstream
tar -xf upstream.tar.xz -C upstream --strip-components=1
find upstream -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort > "$OUT/upstream-files.txt"

mkdir -p "$OUT/upstream-selected"
for rel in CMakeLists.txt src/CMakeLists.txt src/plymouth.knsrc src/kcmplymouth_actions.actions src/kcm.cpp src/kcm.h src/kplymouththemeinstaller.cpp src/helper.cpp src/helper.h; do
    test -f "upstream/$rel"
    mkdir -p "$OUT/upstream-selected/$(dirname "$rel")"
    cp "upstream/$rel" "$OUT/upstream-selected/$rel"
done

cp ubuntu-source/debian/control "$OUT/ubuntu-source-control"
cp ubuntu-source/debian/rules "$OUT/ubuntu-source-rules"
cp ubuntu-source/debian/copyright "$OUT/ubuntu-source-copyright"
cp ubuntu-source/debian/kde-config-plymouth.lintian-overrides "$OUT/ubuntu-lintian-overrides"
cp ubuntu-source/debian/upstream/signing-key.asc "$OUT/upstream-signing-key.asc"

python3 - "$OUT" "$SUPRALINUX_SOURCE_COMMIT" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
source_commit = sys.argv[2]
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
binary_paths = out.joinpath("ubuntu-binary-paths.txt").read_text().splitlines()
result = {
    "schema": 1,
    "state": "PASS",
    "scope": "plymouth-kcm-packaging-review-detail",
    "source_commit": source_commit,
    "node": "plymouth-kcm",
    "ubuntu_source_version": "6.6.4-0ubuntu1",
    "candidate_version": "6.7.5-0supralinux1",
    "ubuntu_debian_tree_sha256": "5eefac021e21e7d2e4ee45a08dbe3a7cb4b9a8169e3cc73e0dbcb089d38ceb37",
    "upstream_sha256": "ce723d67e6b8cd71b6eb353e87c10f698a095ea7d455bee703d8ba59e793e57e",
    "signature_sha256": "60ef1e6ebd75b3d156b2e3687a1e15d05b427085ba24ee3f327960739a2a507d",
    "signature_verification": "PASS",
    "ubuntu_binary_path_count": len(binary_paths),
    "ubuntu_binary_paths_sha256": sha(out/"ubuntu-binary-paths.txt"),
    "ubuntu_binary_control_sha256": sha(out/"ubuntu-binary-control.txt"),
    "upstream_files_sha256": sha(out/"upstream-files.txt"),
    "package_execution_started": False,
    "consumes_package_attempt": False,
    "canonical_package_state_effect": "none",
}
(out/"result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
PY

rm -rf "$WORK"
echo "Plymouth KCM packaging review detail: PASS"
